Manage seek's config file. Stores API keys so you don't have to export env vars each session.

Part of [`seek`](seek.md).

## Usage

```text
seek config [options] [command]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`seek config path`](seek-config-path.md) | Print the resolved config file path. |
| [`seek config init`](seek-config-init.md) | Create a template config file with placeholders for every known API key. |
| [`seek config show`](seek-config-show.md) | Show which API keys are configured (values are masked). |

## Exit statuses

`seek config` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek config --help`:

```text
Usage: seek config [options] [command]

Manage seek's config file. Stores API keys so you don't have to export env vars
each session.

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  path            Print the resolved config file path.
  init [options]  Create a template config file with placeholders for every
                  known API key.
  show            Show which API keys are configured (values are masked).
  help [command]  display help for command
```
